title: Balance Tested against the Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Limit
content:
Loan accounting definitions: on Rural Home Loans, the balance tested against the escrow waiver limit is chosen from the escrow balance and the fees left unpaid.

## Rule

The balance tested against the limit is chosen as follows, the fees unpaid being the fee assessments less the fee payments and fee waivers booked on the loan in the 24 months up to today: when the escrow balance stands below zero, it is the principal balance plus the fees unpaid and the amount escrow has advanced, which the member owes once escrow is closed; when the escrow balance is not below zero but fees are unpaid, it is the principal balance plus those fees; otherwise it is the principal balance.

## Definitions

- **Fees unpaid:** the fee assessments booked on the loan in the 24 months up to today, less the fee payments and less the fee waivers booked on the loan in those 24 months, rounded to the cent. The 24 months run from the day after the same calendar day 24 months before today through today.
- **Amount escrow has advanced:** the amount by which the escrow balance on the loan record stands below zero.

## Cases

| Escrow balance | Fees unpaid | Balance tested |
|---|---|---|
| below zero | any | principal plus fees unpaid plus the escrow advance |
| zero or above | more than zero | principal plus fees unpaid |
| zero or above | none | principal |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, principal 240100.00)

- Escrow balance negative 350.00, fees unpaid 83.00: 240100.00 plus 83.00 plus 350.00, that is 240533.00.
- Escrow balance 120.00, fees unpaid 83.00: 240183.00.
- Escrow balance 120.00, no fees unpaid: 240100.00.
